rows.Origin:
Bred by Wilhelm Kordes III (1953 - 2016) (Germany, before 2003).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2004.
Introduced in Australia by Treloar Roses in 2021 as 'Heaven on Earth'.
rows.Bloom: Peach - apricot. Moderate, spice fragrance. 70 to 80 petals. Average diameter 6". Medium, very full (41+ petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped, rounded bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, compact, spreading, upright. Large, glossy, grey-green, dense, leathery foliage.

Height: 3' to 4' (90 to 120cm). Width: up to 4' (up to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to disease, susceptible to blackspot , mildew resistant, rust resistant.

'KORravreli' bred by Wilhelm Kordes. Resistant to mildew and rust and susceptible to blackspot under normal growing conditions in Somis, California.
rows.Notes: Ludwigs Roses says this rose is dedicated to the Avril Elizabeth Home for the Mentally Handicapped on its 30th anniversary...
